units.leftText: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
units.rightText: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

units.leftText: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord. Faithfulness under Persecution (Matthew 10:16–25|MAT 10:16-25*)
units.rightText: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

units.leftText: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
units.rightText: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers in a pure conscience, how unceasing is my remembrance of thee in my supplications, night and day

units.leftText: Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
units.rightText: longing to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

units.leftText: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
units.rightText: having been reminded of the unfeigned faith that is in thee; which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and, I am persuaded, in thee also.

units.leftText: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
units.rightText: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee through the laying on of my hands.

units.leftText: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
units.rightText: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.

units.leftText: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
units.rightText: Be not ashamed therefore of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but suffer hardship with the gospel according to the power of God;

units.leftText: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
units.rightText: who saved us, and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

units.leftText: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
units.rightText: but hath now been manifested by the appearing of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,

units.leftText: to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
units.rightText: whereunto I was appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher.

units.leftText: For this reason, even though I suffer as I do, I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day. Holding to Sound Teaching
units.rightText: For which cause I suffer also these things: yet I am not ashamed; for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed unto him against that day.
leftNotes: 1:12 Or what He has entrusted to me

units.leftText: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: Hold the pattern of sound words which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

units.leftText: Guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
units.rightText: That good thing which was committed unto thee guard through the Holy Spirit which dwelleth in us.
leftNotes: 1:14 Or the good deposit entrusted to you

units.leftText: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
units.rightText: This thou knowest, that all that are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
leftNotes: 1:15 Literally in Asia; Asia was a Roman province in what is now western Turkey.

units.leftText: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
units.rightText: The Lord grant mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus: for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain;

units.leftText: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.
units.rightText: but, when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me

units.leftText: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
units.rightText: (the Lord grant unto him to find mercy of the Lord in that day); and in how many things he ministered at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

units.leftText: You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: Thou therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

units.leftText: And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.
units.rightText: And the things which thou hast heard from me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

units.leftText: Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: Suffer hardship with me, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

units.leftText: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.
units.rightText: No soldier on service entangleth himself in the affairs of this life; that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

units.leftText: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
units.rightText: And if also a man contend in the games, he is not crowned, except he have contended lawfully.

units.leftText: The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops.
units.rightText: The husbandman that laboreth must be the first to partake of the fruits.

units.leftText: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.
units.rightText: Consider what I say; for the Lord shall give thee understanding in all things.

units.leftText: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel,
units.rightText: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my gospel:

units.leftText: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!
units.rightText: wherein I suffer hardship unto bonds, as a malefactor; but the word of God is not bound.

units.leftText: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
units.rightText: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

units.leftText: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;
units.rightText: Faithful is the saying: For if we died with him, we shall also live with him:

units.leftText: if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;
units.rightText: if we endure, we shall also reign with him: if we shall deny him, he also will deny us:

units.leftText: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself. The Lord’s Approved Workman
units.rightText: if we are faithless, he abideth faithful; for he cannot deny himself.

units.leftText: Remind the believers of these things, charging them before God to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.
units.rightText: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they strive not about words, to no profit, to the subverting of them that hear.
leftNotes: 2:14 SBL, BYZ, and TR the Lord

units.leftText: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
units.rightText: Give diligence to present thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, handling aright the word of truth.

units.leftText: But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
units.rightText: But shun profane babblings: for they will proceed further in ungodliness,

units.leftText: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
units.rightText: and their word will eat as doth a gangrene: of whom is Hymenæus and Philetus;

units.leftText: who have deviated from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already occurred, and they undermine the faith of some.
units.rightText: men who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already, and overthrow the faith of some.

units.leftText: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
units.rightText: Howbeit the firm foundation of God standeth, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his: and, Let every one that nameth the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.

units.leftText: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.
units.rightText: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some unto honor, and some unto dishonor.

units.leftText: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
units.rightText: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honor, sanctified, meet for the master’s use, prepared unto every good work.

units.leftText: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
units.rightText: But flee youthful lusts, and follow after righteousness, faith, love, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

units.leftText: But reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.
units.rightText: But foolish and ignorant questionings refuse, knowing that they gender strifes.

units.leftText: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
units.rightText: And the Lord’s servant must not strive, but be gentle towards all, apt to teach, forbearing,

units.leftText: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
units.rightText: in meekness correcting them that oppose themselves; if peradventure God may give them repentance unto the knowledge of the truth,

units.leftText: Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.
units.rightText: and they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, having been taken captive by him unto his will.

units.leftText: But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.
units.rightText: But know this, that in the last days grievous times shall come.

units.leftText: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
units.rightText: For men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, haughty, railers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

units.leftText: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good,
units.rightText: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,

units.leftText: traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
units.rightText: traitors, headstrong, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;

units.leftText: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!
units.rightText: holding a form of godliness, but having denied the power thereof: from these also turn away.

units.leftText: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
units.rightText: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,

units.leftText: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
units.rightText: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

units.leftText: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
units.rightText: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth; men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.
leftNotes: 3:8 See Jasher 79:27|79:27*. The Book of Jashar or the Book of the Upright One is often cited as Jasher.

units.leftText: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone. All Scripture Is God-Breathed (Hebrews 4:12–16|HEB 4:12-16*)
units.rightText: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be evident unto all men, as theirs also came to be.

units.leftText: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,
units.rightText: But thou didst follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,

units.leftText: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
units.rightText: persecutions, sufferings; what things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: and out of them all the Lord delivered me.

units.leftText: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
units.rightText: Yea, and all that would live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

units.leftText: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
units.rightText: But evil men and impostors shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

units.leftText: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
units.rightText: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

units.leftText: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: and that from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

units.leftText: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
units.rightText: Every scripture inspired of God is also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness:

units.leftText: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
units.rightText: that the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.

units.leftText: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
units.rightText: I charge thee in the sight of God, and of Christ Jesus, who shall judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:

units.leftText: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
units.rightText: preach the word; be urgent in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.

units.leftText: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
units.rightText: For the time will come when they will not endure the sound doctrine; but, having itching ears, will heap to themselves teachers after their own lusts;

units.leftText: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
units.rightText: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside unto fables.

units.leftText: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
units.rightText: But be thou sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfil thy ministry.

units.leftText: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
units.rightText: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure is come.

units.leftText: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
units.rightText: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:

units.leftText: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day — and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing. Personal Concerns
units.rightText: henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give to me at that day; and not to me only, but also to all them that have loved his appearing.

units.leftText: Make every effort to come to me quickly,
units.rightText: Give diligence to come shortly unto me:

units.leftText: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
units.rightText: for Demas forsook me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

units.leftText: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
units.rightText: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee; for he is useful to me for ministering.

units.leftText: Tychicus, however, I have sent to Ephesus.
units.rightText: But Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

units.leftText: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
units.rightText: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, bring when thou comest, and the books, especially the parchments.

units.leftText: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
units.rightText: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord will render to him according to his works:

units.leftText: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message. The Lord Remains Faithful
units.rightText: of whom do thou also beware; for he greatly withstood our words.

units.leftText: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
units.rightText: At my first defence no one took my part, but all forsook me: may it not be laid to their account.

units.leftText: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
units.rightText: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me; that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

units.leftText: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings (Ephesians 6:21–24|EPH 6:21-24*; Philippians 4:21–23|PHP 4:21-23*)
units.rightText: The Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will save me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Greet Prisca and Aquila, as well as the household of Onesiphorus.
units.rightText: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
leftNotes: 4:19 Prisca is a variant of Priscilla; see Acts 18:2|ACT 18:2*.

units.leftText: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.
units.rightText: Erastus remained at Corinth: but Trophimus I left at Miletus sick.

units.leftText: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
units.rightText: Give diligence to come before winter. Eubulus saluteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

units.leftText: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
units.rightText: The Lord be with thy spirit. Grace be with you.
